description: This file defines a mock implementation of the MessageMapper interface for testing purposes within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for configuration and message mapping, with placeholder logic returning empty collections.

classes.name: MockMapper
classes.description: A mock implementation of the MessageMapper interface for testing.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this mapper.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns an empty collection representing no blocked content types.

methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided mapping configuration and validation.

methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects (returns empty list).

methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessages (returns empty list).

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns empty map of incoming conditions.
